entries.text: Greetings, my little students. Whatever you did\nyesterday, it is now a part of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_01

entries.text:
I was hoping to continue unraveling the marvels
that history has presented to us today.\c
However, I imagine your ability to concentrate
has been spectacularly derailed by my midterm.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_02

entries.text: I suppose changing things up for fun and variety\nmay be a good idea every now and then.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_03

entries.text: So allow me to tell you an old fairy tale that has\nbeen passed down in Paldea for generations.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_04

entries.text: Once upon a time, there was a king who very\nmuch enjoyed collecting treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_05

entries.text:
He was particularly fond of treasures from
other countries.\c
One day, a merchant from the East heard rumors
of this king and came to meet him.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_06

entries.text: The merchant laid out four treasures in front of\nthe treasure-loving king.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_07

entries.text: The four treasures were as follows: a vessel, a\nsword, a set of tablets, and a set of beads.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_08

entries.text: Seeing such rarities before him, the king leaped\nfor joy.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_09

entries.text: He showered the merchant with gold coins and\nclaimed all four of the treasures for himself.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_10

entries.text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Answer me this...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_11

entries.text: I said that one of the treasures was a “set of\ntablets.” What do you think these tablets were?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_12

entries.text: Wooden planks for writing on
entries.label: class_c_05_select_01

entries.text: Handheld electronic devices
entries.label: class_c_05_select_02

entries.text: Medicine that you chew
entries.label: class_c_05_select_03

entries.text: Correct! Your daily pursuit of knowledge serves\nyou well.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_answer_01

entries.text: Incorrect! Is that some kind of joke? Were you\nexpecting me to laugh at your assumption that\r\nelectronic tablets existed in the distant past?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_answer_02

entries.text: Incorrect! Is that some kind of joke? Were you\nexpecting me to laugh at the notion that\r\nchewable tablets would be considered treasure?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_answer_03

entries.text: These particular tablets were wooden and used\nas a writing medium in the East in ancient times.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_13

entries.text: As you may know, they fell out of popular use\nas paper become more universally available.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_14

entries.text:
For the king to consider these paper substitutes
treasures, they must have been of superb quality.\c
That, or perhaps they had some amazingly
profound teachings written on them.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_15

entries.text: So, the king obtained these four treasures, and\non that very night...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_16

entries.text: it is said that a terrible disaster rained down upon\nhis castle, reducing it to rubble by dawn.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_17

entries.text: Oho, is that the time already? I wasn’t done with\nmy story, but alas. So ends today’s lesson.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_18

entries.text: If you are interested in how the story ends,\nyou may come see me outside class hours.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_05_history_19
